reviews.comment: He is very research oriented, I definitely wasn't prepared to understand anything in class as it was a bit more sophisticated than what I know, but the course's main purpose was to introduce the field of study more than learning the material.

Compared to other BICH101 profs, Dr. Zhang's class was very simple; I could tell that he focuses on his research instead of teaching. Lectures entire class over interesting info from his research and the CPT. Had only 1-2 easy homework assignments, an attendance question once in a blue moon, and an easy, informal end-of-semester group presentation.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things
